current.text: He signed with Houston on a minimum contract.
Experts, Lloyd among them, think he might be washed.
He is seen as an upgrade over Aaron Holiday on the Houston bench.
He will probably get the last spot in the rotation.
Houston's guard rotation is crowded with Fred VanVleet, Amen Thompson, Marcus Smart and Reed Sheppard.
Coach Ime Udoka plays his starters very heavy minutes.
With our March 28 end date, Houston plays 3, 3 and 4 games in fantasy playoff weeks 19 to 21, 10 games in total. The team has only 14 back-to-backs this season.

note: Both sites give him 0 USD of value and rank him 408 (Yahoo) and 277 (ESPN), far outside the 144 players we draft, so do not draft him. He projects for about 18 minutes as the last man in a deep Houston guard group under a coach who plays his starters heavy minutes. His only categories that are not negative are FT% and low turnovers, and they come on tiny volume. Early in the season, check only whether a guard injury gives him real minutes and whether his shooting has recovered from 38.8% FG last season.
